task.title: Capture a Payment
task.shortdesc: Capture funds from an authorized PayPal payment using the Payments API.

ul.li: An order created with "intent": "AUTHORIZE" and status APPROVED
The authorization id from the order response

step.cmd: Retrieve the authorization ID from the approved order.
Capture the authorization to collect funds.

info.codeblock: curl -X POST \ https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/v2/payments/authorizations/AUTH_ID/capture \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer A21AAFEpH4PsADbl..." \ -H "PayPal-Request-Id: capture-auth-001" \ -d '{ "amount": { "currency_code": "USD", "value": "220.00" }, "final_capture": true, "note_to_payer": "Thank you for your order! Shipping in 2 days.", "invoice_id": "INV-12345" }'

step.cmd: Verify the response status is COMPLETED.
step.stepresult: Funds collected. Store the capture id for refund operations.

result.p: The authorization is captured and funds move to your PayPal account.
